title: Evaluation of Contextual Understanding in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.09004v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive performance across diverse NLP tasks, yet their ability to exhibit genuine contextual understanding remains uncertain. Traditional evaluation metrics such as perplexity, BiLingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU), or surface-level accuracy fail to reveal how well LLMs extract, integrate, and reason over contextual information--a gap particularly critical in question answering, where models must align responses with contextually grounded knowledge rather than memorized associations. We propose a novel knowledge graph-based evaluation framework introducing Semantic Structural Similarity for KGs (S3KG), a hybrid similarity measure integrating structural and semantic similarity into a continuous evaluation score, alongside a diagnostic framework for categorizing reasoning errors. To validate this pipeline, we evaluate S3KG against established metrics on a curated question-answer (QA) benchmar

translated_title: 大语言模型情境理解能力的评估
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在各类自然语言处理任务中展现出令人瞩目的性能，但其是否具备真正的情境理解能力仍不确定。传统评估指标如困惑度、双语评估替补（BLEU）或表层准确率无法揭示大语言模型在提取、整合和推理情境信息方面的能力——这一缺陷在问答任务中尤为关键，因为模型必须使回答与基于情境的知识保持一致，而非依赖记忆中的关联。我们提出了一种新颖的基于知识图谱的评估框架，引入了面向知识图谱的语义结构相似度（S3KG），这是一种将结构相似度与语义相似度整合为连续评估分数的混合相似度度量，同时还提供了一个用于分类推理错误的诊断框架。为了验证该流程，我们在一个精选的问答基准上，将S3KG与现有指标进行了对比评估。
tldr: 本文提出基于知识图谱的S3KG评估框架，通过融合结构相似度与语义相似度来量化评估大语言模型的情境理解能力，并提供诊断推理错误的分类框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes S3KG, a knowledge graph-based evaluation framework that integrates structural and semantic similarity to quantitatively assess the contextual understanding of LLMs, along with a diagnostic framework for categorizing reasoning errors.
